profile.name: GSV-3USB传感器测量放大器
profile.description: 这是一种通过 USB 连接的传感器测量放大器/信号调理设备，常用于连接应变片式力传感器、称重传感器等，将传感器输出转换为可读取的数字测量值。在实验室中可用于力、重量或相关模拟信号的采集，并支持清零、偏置、量程极性与连续数据传输等操作。
profile.description_en: This is a USB-connected sensor measurement amplifier and signal-conditioning unit, typically used with strain-gauge force sensors, load cells, and similar transducers. It converts sensor output into readable digital measurements for laboratory force, weight, or related analog-signal acquisition, and supports zeroing, offset adjustment, polarity/range selection, and continuous data transmission.

registry.name: GSV-3 USB Strain Gauge Amplifier
registry.description: GSV-3 USB Strain Gauge Amplifier是由ME-Meßsysteme生产的表征设备，主要功能包括停止、启动、归零校准、数据保存、读取数据。
